hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a buy-and-burn pot per pool: on sells, beforeSwap absorbs up to the pot's balance at the pool's own execution price and returns a delta (shield); on buys, afterSwap uses pot reserves to market-buy the main token (pump). Optionally manages a hook-held concentrated-liquidity position whose fees are auto-harvested and auto-compounded on each swap.
